excerpt_en: Pregnancy increases requirements for selected nutrients and regular antenatal assessment. Needs depend on health, gestational stage and local care guidance.
excerpt_hi: गर्भावस्था में कुछ पोषक तत्वों और नियमित प्रसवपूर्व जांच की जरूरत बढ़ती है। जरूरत स्वास्थ्य, गर्भ की अवस्था और स्थानीय सलाह पर निर्भर है।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Pregnancy increases requirements for selected nutrients and regular antenatal assessment. Needs depend on health, gestational stage and local care guidance.

## Practical guidance

Eat varied meals with protein, vegetables, whole grains and safe dairy or alternatives. Discuss folic acid, iron, calcium, vaccination and scheduled tests with the antenatal team.

## Important considerations and next steps

Bleeding, severe headache, visual changes, severe abdominal pain or reduced fetal movement when established needs prompt assessment. Avoid alcohol and unapproved medicines.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.
content_hi:
## विषय को समझें

गर्भावस्था में कुछ पोषक तत्वों और नियमित प्रसवपूर्व जांच की जरूरत बढ़ती है। जरूरत स्वास्थ्य, गर्भ की अवस्था और स्थानीय सलाह पर निर्भर है।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

प्रोटीन, सब्जी, साबुत अनाज और सुरक्षित दूध या विकल्प के साथ विविध भोजन लें। फोलिक एसिड, आयरन, कैल्शियम, टीके और जांच पर टीम से पूछें।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

रक्तस्राव, तेज सिरदर्द, दृष्टि बदलाव, तेज पेट दर्द या स्थापित भ्रूण गति में कमी पर तुरंत जांच कराएं। शराब और बिना सलाह की दवा से बचें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

title_en: Millets: nutrition, benefits and practical meal ideas
title_hi: मोटे अनाज: पोषण, लाभ और भोजन के व्यावहारिक विकल्प
excerpt_en: Millets such as bajra, jowar and ragi are diverse grains providing carbohydrates, fibre and varying micronutrients.
excerpt_hi: बाजरा, ज्वार और रागी जैसे मिलेट विविध अनाज हैं जिनमें कार्बोहाइड्रेट, फाइबर और अलग-अलग सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व होते हैं।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Millets such as bajra, jowar and ragi are diverse grains providing carbohydrates, fibre and varying micronutrients.

## Practical guidance

Use them in roti, khichdi or porridge and pair with dal, vegetables and protein. Nutrient content and glucose response depend on variety, processing and meal composition.

## Important considerations and next steps

Millets are not a cure for diabetes. Introduce fibre gradually and choose portions appropriate to individual energy and glucose goals.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

title_en: Heart-healthy Indian meals and cooking habits
title_hi: हृदय के लिए स्वास्थ्यकर भारतीय भोजन और पाक आदतें
excerpt_en: A heart-healthy Indian meal pattern emphasises vegetables, fruit, pulses, whole grains and appropriate unsaturated fats.
excerpt_hi: हृदय के अनुकूल भारतीय आहार में सब्जी, फल, दाल, साबुत अनाज और उपयुक्त असंतृप्त वसा पर जोर होता है।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

A heart-healthy Indian meal pattern emphasises vegetables, fruit, pulses, whole grains and appropriate unsaturated fats.

## Practical guidance

Try dal with sabzi and roti, curd without added sugar, or vegetable khichdi with a protein side. Limit frequent deep-fried snacks, excess salt and sugary drinks.

## Important considerations and next steps

Adjust meals to diabetes, kidney disease or heart failure advice rather than applying a single diet to everyone. Consistency matters more than one special food.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

हृदय के अनुकूल भारतीय आहार में सब्जी, फल, दाल, साबुत अनाज और उपयुक्त असंतृप्त वसा पर जोर होता है।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

मधुमेह, गुर्दे की बीमारी या हृदय विफलता की सलाह के अनुसार भोजन बदलें। एक विशेष भोजन से अधिक नियमितता जरूरी है।

title_en: Complementary feeding: introducing foods safely to infants
title_hi: पूरक आहार: शिशुओं को सुरक्षित तरीके से भोजन शुरू कराना
excerpt_en: Complementary feeding generally begins around six months when milk alone no longer meets all nutritional needs and the infant is developmentally ready.
excerpt_hi: पूरक आहार आमतौर पर छह महीने के आसपास शुरू होता है जब केवल दूध पर्याप्त नहीं होता और शिशु विकास के अनुसार तैयार हो।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Complementary feeding generally begins around six months when milk alone no longer meets all nutritional needs and the infant is developmentally ready.

## Practical guidance

Continue breastfeeding where possible, introduce soft nutrient-dense foods with iron and gradually advance texture. Feed responsively while the child sits upright and is supervised.

## Important considerations and next steps

Avoid honey before twelve months, whole nuts and other choking hazards. Discuss poor growth, swallowing problems or suspected food allergy with a paediatrician.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.
content_hi:
## विषय को समझें

पूरक आहार आमतौर पर छह महीने के आसपास शुरू होता है जब केवल दूध पर्याप्त नहीं होता और शिशु विकास के अनुसार तैयार हो।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

संभव हो तो स्तनपान जारी रखें, आयरन वाला नरम पौष्टिक भोजन दें और बनावट धीरे बढ़ाएं। बच्चे को सीधा बैठाकर निगरानी में उसकी भूख के संकेत अनुसार खिलाएं।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

बारह महीने से पहले शहद, साबुत मेवे और दम घुटने वाले खाद्य न दें। कम वृद्धि, निगलने की समस्या या एलर्जी पर बाल रोग विशेषज्ञ से पूछें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

title_en: Snakebite first aid in India: safe response and harmful myths
title_hi: भारत में सर्पदंश: सुरक्षित प्राथमिक उपचार और हानिकारक मिथक
excerpt_en: Snakebite may be life-threatening even when initial pain or swelling is mild. The type of snake is often uncertain.
excerpt_hi: सांप का काटना जानलेवा हो सकता है, भले शुरुआत में दर्द या सूजन कम हो। सांप का प्रकार अक्सर स्पष्ट नहीं होता।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Snakebite may be life-threatening even when initial pain or swelling is mild. The type of snake is often uncertain.

## Practical guidance

Move away safely, keep the person still, remove tight jewellery and immobilise the affected limb without cutting off circulation. Arrange urgent transport to a hospital.

## Important considerations and next steps

Do not cut, suck, apply ice, use a tight tourniquet or attempt to catch the snake. Antivenom decisions require hospital assessment; do not delay for traditional remedies.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.
content_hi:
## विषय को समझें

सांप का काटना जानलेवा हो सकता है, भले शुरुआत में दर्द या सूजन कम हो। सांप का प्रकार अक्सर स्पष्ट नहीं होता।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

सुरक्षित दूरी बनाएं, व्यक्ति को स्थिर रखें, तंग आभूषण हटाएं और रक्त प्रवाह रोके बिना प्रभावित अंग स्थिर रखें। तुरंत अस्पताल पहुंचाने की व्यवस्था करें।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

घाव न काटें, न चूसें, बर्फ या कसा टॉर्निकेट न लगाएं और सांप पकड़ने का प्रयास न करें। एंटीवेनम का निर्णय अस्पताल में होता है; घरेलू उपचार के लिए देर न करें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

title_en: Fever in children: home care and warning signs
title_hi: बच्चों में बुखार: घरेलू देखभाल और चेतावनी संकेत
excerpt_en: Fever is a sign of illness, not a diagnosis. The child's age, alertness, breathing and hydration matter more than temperature alone.
excerpt_hi: बुखार बीमारी का संकेत है, निदान नहीं। तापमान के अलावा बच्चे की उम्र, चेतना, सांस और जलयोजन महत्वपूर्ण हैं।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Fever is a sign of illness, not a diagnosis. The child's age, alertness, breathing and hydration matter more than temperature alone.

## Practical guidance

Offer fluids, allow rest and use a reliable thermometer. Fever medicine may improve comfort when appropriately dosed; avoid aspirin in children unless specifically prescribed.

## Important considerations and next steps

Any fever of 38°C or above in a baby under three months needs urgent assessment. Breathing trouble, nonblanching rash, seizures or marked lethargy also needs urgent care.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.
content_hi:
## विषय को समझें

बुखार बीमारी का संकेत है, निदान नहीं। तापमान के अलावा बच्चे की उम्र, चेतना, सांस और जलयोजन महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

तरल दें, आराम कराएं और विश्वसनीय थर्मामीटर लें। उचित मात्रा की बुखार दवा आराम दे सकती है। विशेष निर्देश के बिना बच्चों को एस्पिरिन न दें।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

तीन महीने से कम शिशु में 38°C या अधिक बुखार की तुरंत जांच कराएं। सांस की कठिनाई, दबाने पर न मिटने वाले चकत्ते, दौरे या अधिक सुस्ती में भी तुरंत मदद लें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

title_en: Poisoning at home: emergency steps and prevention
title_hi: घर में विषाक्तता: आपात कदम और बचाव

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Poisoning can occur through swallowing, breathing or skin contact with medicines, cleaners and pesticides.

## Practical guidance

Move away from exposure safely, call emergency services and retain the product container for clinicians. Do not induce vomiting or give food or drink unless directed.

## Important considerations and next steps

Store chemicals in original labelled containers, locked away from children. Never mix cleaning agents or transfer chemicals into drink bottles.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

title_en: Chair yoga for limited mobility and older adults
title_hi: सीमित गतिशीलता और बुजुर्गों के लिए कुर्सी योग
excerpt_en: Chair yoga adapts movements to seated or supported positions and may make activity accessible to people with reduced mobility.
excerpt_hi: कुर्सी योग में बैठकर या सहारे से गति की जाती है, जिससे सीमित गतिशीलता वाले लोग भी गतिविधि कर सकते हैं।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Chair yoga adapts movements to seated or supported positions and may make activity accessible to people with reduced mobility.

## Practical guidance

Use a stable chair without wheels on a nonslip surface. Begin with comfortable shoulder rolls, ankle movements and gentle seated rotations while breathing normally.

## Understanding the topic

Anulom Vilom is a form of alternate-nostril breathing traditionally practised in yoga. Gentle versions may promote relaxation.

## Practical guidance

Sit comfortably, gently close one nostril, inhale through the other and switch sides for a comfortable exhalation. Alternate without force or long breath holds.

## Important considerations and next steps

Stop if dizzy, congested or uncomfortable. Evidence does not establish it as a cure for hypertension or lung disease.

## Understanding the topic

Fermented foods are produced through microbial activity. Probiotics are specific live microorganisms with demonstrated benefits in adequate amounts; not every fermented food is probiotic.

Curd and other safely prepared fermented foods can fit a balanced diet. Effects of probiotic products depend on the strain, dose and condition studied.

## Important considerations and next steps

Do not assume all supplements treat gut symptoms. People who are severely ill or immunocompromised should discuss probiotic supplements with a clinician.

Irritable bowel syndrome is a disorder of gut-brain interaction involving recurring abdominal pain and altered bowel habits.

Constipation, diarrhoea or both may occur. Diagnosis considers symptom patterns and excludes selected other conditions. A diary can identify individual food or stress associations.

## Important considerations and next steps

Regular meals, soluble fibre where suitable and dietitian-guided dietary changes may help. Blood in stool, fever or unintended weight loss requires evaluation.

Erectile dysfunction means persistent difficulty achieving or maintaining an erection adequate for desired sexual activity. Vascular, neurological, hormonal and psychological factors may contribute.

## Understanding the topic

Insulin resistance means tissues respond less effectively to insulin, so the pancreas may need to produce more to maintain glucose levels.

## Practical guidance

It is associated with metabolic conditions including prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Blood glucose and HbA1c assess glycaemic status; routine insulin testing is not always necessary.

## Important considerations and next steps

Regular activity, adequate sleep and balanced meals can support insulin sensitivity. Discuss screening based on family history and metabolic risk.

Postpartum recovery involves healing after birth, hormonal changes, feeding demands and adjustment to caring for a newborn.

Depression is more than temporary sadness; persistent low mood or loss of interest can occur with sleep, appetite, concentration and energy changes.

## Understanding the topic

Knee pain during exercise may reflect overload, tendon irritation, joint disease or an injury; location and onset help guide assessment.

## Practical guidance

Reduce painful loads temporarily, choose tolerable range of motion and consider cycling or other lower-impact alternatives. Strengthening surrounding muscles may help when appropriately tailored.

## Important considerations and next steps

A hot swollen joint with fever, inability to bear weight after injury or a locked knee needs prompt assessment. Do not train through sharp or worsening pain.

## Understanding the topic

Body mass index is weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared. It is a screening measure, not a direct measurement of body fat.

## Practical guidance

Interpret BMI alongside waist circumference, health history and physical function. Asian populations may develop metabolic risk at lower BMI values; children's results require age-specific charts.

## Important considerations and next steps

Pregnancy, high muscle mass and fluid retention can make BMI misleading. Avoid using the number alone to judge health or self-worth.

## Understanding the topic

Alcohol can affect liver, heart, sleep, sexual function and mental health, and contributes to several cancers. Risk generally rises with consumption.

## Practical guidance

Track actual drinks, avoid drinking before driving and consider alcohol-free alternatives. Discuss medications and existing illness with a clinician because interactions can be dangerous.

## Important considerations and next steps

People with dependence may experience dangerous withdrawal after abrupt cessation; seek medical support for a safe plan. Less alcohol reduces exposure to harm.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Burnout describes work-related exhaustion, mental distance or cynicism, and reduced professional efficacy associated with chronic unmanaged workplace stress.

## Practical guidance

Identify workload, role ambiguity, low control and insufficient recovery. Discuss realistic priorities, boundaries and organisational changes, rather than relying only on individual coping.

## Important considerations and next steps

Persistent low mood, anxiety, sleep impairment or inability to function may need clinical assessment for conditions beyond burnout.

Period cramps can result from uterine contractions; severe or progressively worsening pain may have secondary causes such as endometriosis.

Track pain timing, flow and effect on daily activities. Heat may relieve ordinary cramps, and clinician-approved pain medicines or hormonal options can help some people.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Serotonin is a signalling molecule involved in mood, sleep, appetite and gut function. Its effects depend on receptors and biological pathways.

## Practical guidance

Depression cannot be reduced to a simple serotonin deficiency. Antidepressants affecting serotonin can help some people, but response varies and other mechanisms matter.

## Important considerations and next steps

Avoid combining serotonergic supplements or medicines without professional advice. Fever, agitation, muscle rigidity or confusion after a medication change requires urgent assessment.

Prolonged near work and reduced blinking can cause digital eye strain, dryness and temporary blurred vision.

## Practical guidance

Take regular distance-viewing breaks, blink deliberately, adjust glare and screen position, and use appropriate prescription lenses. Outdoor time is useful for children's eye health.

## Important considerations and next steps

Sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, flashes with a new curtain-like shadow or chemical injury needs urgent assessment. Persistent symptoms warrant an eye examination.

## Understanding the topic

Air pollution includes fine particles and gases that can affect lungs, blood vessels and the heart. Exposure varies with traffic, weather and indoor sources.

## Practical guidance

Check local air-quality advisories, reduce strenuous outdoor activity during severe pollution and avoid indoor smoke. A well-fitting particulate respirator may reduce particle exposure when appropriate.

## Important considerations and next steps

People with asthma or heart disease should follow their action plans. A mask does not filter every pollutant; persistent or severe breathing difficulty requires medical care.

Asthma is a chronic airway condition involving inflammation and variable narrowing that can cause wheeze, cough and breathlessness.

## Practical guidance

Triggers vary and may include viral infections, smoke, allergens or exercise. Spirometry helps assessment; inhaler technique and a written action plan are central to care.

निर्धारित सूजन नियंत्रण और राहत उपचार लें। गंभीर सांस फूलना, बोल न पाना या आपात योजना से राहत न मिलने पर तुरंत मदद लें।

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Supplements and herbal products can contain biologically active ingredients and may interact with medicines. Natural does not automatically mean safe.

## Practical guidance

Check evidence for the specific ingredient, dose and purpose, and look for reliable manufacturing quality. Inform clinicians about all products before surgery or pregnancy.

## Important considerations and next steps

Avoid products promising cures, hidden ingredients or rapid results. Stop and seek advice for unexpected adverse effects; do not replace prescribed therapy without guidance.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Digital overload can arise from constant notifications, multitasking and lack of recovery time, rather than screen duration alone.

## Practical guidance

Batch notifications, choose focused work intervals, create screen-free meals and bedtime routines, and distinguish purposeful use from automatic scrolling.

## Important considerations and next steps

Changes should support work, relationships and sleep, not impose unrealistic abstinence. Persistent anxiety, sleep disruption or impaired functioning may need professional help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

An ECG records electrical activity; an echocardiogram uses ultrasound to assess heart structure and pumping; a stress test evaluates responses to exertion or medicines.

## Practical guidance

The correct test depends on symptoms and clinical questions. A normal resting ECG does not exclude all heart disease, and an abnormal result needs context.

## Important considerations and next steps

Discuss preparation, medication instructions and what results mean with the ordering clinician. Acute chest pain or severe breathlessness should not wait for routine testing.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Diarrhoea in children can cause dehydration rapidly, especially in infants. Most acute cases need supportive hydration, though causes differ.

## Practical guidance

Give properly prepared ORS in frequent small amounts, continue breastfeeding and age-appropriate feeding. Zinc may be recommended by a clinician according to age and local guidance.

## Important considerations and next steps

Blood in stool, inability to drink, repeated vomiting, very little urine or unusual sleepiness needs prompt assessment. Avoid self-prescribed antidiarrhoeal medicines in children.

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Recovery is the period when the body adapts to exercise. Training load, sleep, nutrition and rest influence performance and injury risk.

## Practical guidance

Allow sufficient rest between hard sessions, eat adequate energy and protein and replace fluids. Gentle activity may be comfortable after ordinary muscle soreness.

## Important considerations and next steps

Sharp pain, swelling or loss of function is not ordinary soreness. Severe muscle pain with dark urine requires urgent assessment.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Iron deficiency anaemia occurs when insufficient iron limits haemoglobin production. Blood loss, increased needs and low intake or absorption can contribute.

## Practical guidance

Fatigue, pallor and breathlessness may occur. CBC and ferritin are commonly used, with interpretation affected by inflammation. The underlying cause must be assessed.

## Important considerations and next steps

Iron-rich foods and prescribed iron may help, but unexplained blood loss needs investigation. Keep iron tablets away from children because overdose is dangerous.

title_en: Emergency contraception: timing and available options
title_hi: आपातकालीन गर्भनिरोध: समय और उपलब्ध विकल्प
excerpt_en: Emergency contraception reduces pregnancy risk after unprotected sex or contraceptive failure. It is time-sensitive and does not end an established pregnancy.
excerpt_hi: आपात गर्भनिरोध असुरक्षित संभोग या गर्भनिरोध विफल होने के बाद गर्भ का जोखिम घटाता है। समय महत्वपूर्ण है और इससे स्थापित गर्भ समाप्त नहीं होता।
content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Emergency contraception reduces pregnancy risk after unprotected sex or contraceptive failure. It is time-sensitive and does not end an established pregnancy.

## Practical guidance

Oral options and a copper intrauterine device have different time windows and suitability. Contact a pharmacist or clinician as soon as possible; do not delay while estimating ovulation.

## Important considerations and next steps

It does not protect against sexually transmitted infections or later unprotected sex. Ask about ongoing contraception, pregnancy testing and STI assessment; seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

गोली और कॉपर आईयूडी की समय सीमा व उपयुक्तता अलग हैं। जल्दी फार्मासिस्ट या डॉक्टर से संपर्क करें; अंडोत्सर्जन का अनुमान लगाकर देर न करें।

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Loneliness is the subjective feeling of insufficient connection, while social isolation describes limited contact. Either can affect wellbeing.

## Practical guidance

Identify meaningful, manageable opportunities for connection such as a shared activity, regular call or community group. Quality matters as well as frequency.

## Important considerations and next steps

Persistent loneliness with low mood, withdrawal or sleep problems can warrant mental health support. Avoid blaming individuals for barriers such as disability or caregiving.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

Vitamin B12 supports nerve function and blood cell formation. Deficiency may result from low intake, malabsorption or certain medicines.

Vegetarians and vegans may need fortified foods or supplementation. Fatigue, numbness, balance problems and memory changes can occur; blood testing and clinical assessment guide diagnosis.

## Important considerations and next steps

Treatment may be oral or injectable depending on cause. Neurological symptoms need timely evaluation because prolonged deficiency can cause lasting harm.

## Understanding the topic

Desk discomfort often reflects sustained positions, repetitive work and insufficient movement rather than one universally wrong posture.

## Practical guidance

Adjust screen height and chair support, keep input devices within easy reach and change position frequently. Short movement breaks and comfortable strengthening can help.

## Important considerations and next steps

Persistent radiating pain, weakness or numbness needs assessment. New bladder or bowel dysfunction with back pain requires urgent care.

## Understanding the topic

Pharmacovigilance collects suspected adverse drug reactions to identify safety signals. A report can be useful even if causality is uncertain.

## Practical guidance

Record the medicine name, strength, timing, symptoms, other medicines and outcome. In India, discuss reporting through the Pharmacovigilance Programme of India and its official patient reporting channels.

## Important considerations and next steps

Reporting is not a substitute for treatment. Severe allergic reaction, breathing difficulty or other emergency symptoms need immediate medical help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Mindfulness involves paying attention to present experience with less automatic judgement. It is a skill that can be practised in ordinary activities.

## Practical guidance

Try sitting comfortably for a few minutes, noticing sensations or breath and returning attention when distracted. Walking or listening mindfully are alternatives to sitting.

## Important considerations and next steps

Benefits vary and some people experience distress. Modify or stop if practice is uncomfortable; professional mental health care remains important when needed.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Burn injury severity depends on depth, extent, location and cause. Immediate cooling can reduce ongoing thermal damage.

## Practical guidance

Cool a thermal burn under cool running water for 20 minutes as soon as possible. Remove loose jewellery or clothing unless stuck, then cover loosely with a clean nonfluffy dressing.

## Important considerations and next steps

Do not use ice, toothpaste, ghee or break blisters. Deep, large, electrical, chemical or airway burns and burns to critical areas require urgent medical assessment.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

बर्फ, टूथपेस्ट, घी न लगाएं और फफोले न फोड़ें। गहरे, बड़े, बिजली, रसायन, श्वास मार्ग या महत्वपूर्ण भाग के जलने में तुरंत जांच कराएं।

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Sexually transmitted infections can spread through sexual contact and many cause no noticeable symptoms. Testing is essential because appearance alone cannot exclude infection.

## Practical guidance

Use condoms correctly, discuss testing with partners and consider HPV or hepatitis B vaccination when appropriate. Tests depend on exposure sites, timing and specific infections.

## Important considerations and next steps

Seek treatment for unusual discharge, sores or pelvic pain and follow partner-notification advice. After possible HIV exposure, urgent assessment for post-exposure prophylaxis is time-sensitive.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Kidney stones form when substances in urine crystallise. They can cause severe flank pain, nausea or blood in urine, although some are silent.

## Practical guidance

Imaging and urine or blood tests help assess stone size, obstruction and infection. Treatment varies from pain management and observation to procedures.

## Important considerations and next steps

Fever with stone symptoms, inability to urinate or uncontrolled pain needs urgent care. Prevention depends on stone type; adequate fluid and lower excess salt often help when appropriate.

## Understanding the topic

Children's digital habits should be assessed by age, content, context and whether screen use displaces sleep, play and interaction.

## Practical guidance

Create family media routines, co-view age-appropriate content, keep devices away from bedtime and encourage outdoor activity and face-to-face play.

## Important considerations and next steps

Avoid using screens as the only way to soothe distress. Discuss persistent sleep, behaviour or developmental concerns with a paediatrician.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Hypertension means persistently elevated blood pressure and often causes no symptoms. Over time it raises heart, brain and kidney risk.

## Practical guidance

Use a validated upper-arm device with correct cuff size, rest before measurements and record repeated readings. Diagnosis and treatment targets require clinical context.

## Important considerations and next steps

Reduce excess salt, avoid tobacco, stay active and take prescribed treatment. Very high readings accompanied by chest pain, neurological symptoms or severe breathlessness require emergency care.

## Understanding the topic

Persistent infection with high-risk HPV causes most cervical cancers. Vaccination reduces risk and screening can identify precancerous changes.

## Practical guidance

Discuss HPV vaccine eligibility and cervical screening methods such as HPV testing, visual inspection or cytology according to local guidance and age.

## Important considerations and next steps

Vaccinated individuals may still need screening. Bleeding after sex, unusual bleeding or persistent pelvic symptoms requires evaluation rather than waiting for screening.

## Understanding the topic

Sexual consent is a voluntary, informed and ongoing agreement to a specific activity. Silence, pressure or prior agreement does not establish current consent.

## Practical guidance

Communicate boundaries clearly, check in with partners and respect any decision to stop. A person who is unconscious or unable to understand or freely decide cannot consent.

## Important considerations and next steps

Seek confidential support if coercion or assault occurs. Prioritise immediate safety and timely medical care, including discussion of pregnancy and infection prevention where relevant.

## Understanding the topic

Falls in older adults can result from poor balance, vision changes, medication effects or environmental hazards. Many risks are modifiable.

## Practical guidance

Improve lighting, secure loose rugs, install appropriate bathroom supports and use well-fitting shoes. Strength and balance training and medication review can help.

## Important considerations and next steps

Repeated falls, fainting or a fall with head injury needs assessment, especially when taking blood thinners. Avoid restricting all activity out of fear.

Bhramari is a breathing practice involving a gentle humming sound during exhalation. It may feel calming, but evidence for specific disease treatment remains limited.

## Practical guidance

Sit comfortably, inhale naturally and exhale with a soft hum at a comfortable pitch. Repeat a few times without forcing breath or blocking airflow.

## Important considerations and next steps

Stop if dizzy, uncomfortable or short of breath. Do not use humming exercises instead of treatment for anxiety, hypertension or respiratory illness.

HbA1c reflects average glucose exposure over roughly two to three months, while a glucose reading describes a specific point in time.

## Practical guidance

Fasting, random and post-meal glucose tests answer different questions. Anaemia, haemoglobin variants and altered red cell turnover may distort HbA1c interpretation.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Choking is airway obstruction. A person who can cough effectively should be encouraged to cough; inability to speak, cough or breathe indicates severe obstruction.

## Practical guidance

Call 112. For a conscious adult or child over one year with severe obstruction, give up to five back blows followed by up to five abdominal thrusts; repeat and follow dispatcher guidance. For infants use five back blows and five chest thrusts, never abdominal thrusts.

## Important considerations and next steps

If unresponsive, begin CPR as directed. Do not blindly sweep the mouth. Use chest rather than abdominal thrusts when abdominal thrusts cannot be safely performed, such as late pregnancy; seek assessment after significant choking.

## Understanding the topic

Hypoglycaemia is abnormally low blood glucose, often associated with insulin or certain diabetes medicines. Sweating, tremor, hunger or confusion may occur.

## Practical guidance

If an adult is alert and can swallow, use the prescribed plan, commonly 15 grams of fast-acting carbohydrate followed by a glucose recheck after 15 minutes and repeat if still low.

## Important considerations and next steps

For unconsciousness or inability to swallow, give nothing by mouth; call emergency help and use prescribed glucagon if available and trained. Discuss recurrent episodes with the diabetes team.

## Understanding the topic

Heat exhaustion can cause heavy sweating, weakness, nausea and dizziness. Heatstroke involves dangerous overheating with altered mental status and is an emergency.

## Practical guidance

Move to shade, remove excess clothing and cool the person. If alert and able to swallow, offer fluids for heat exhaustion. Suspected heatstroke requires emergency help and rapid active cooling.

## Important considerations and next steps

Do not wait for sweating to stop before recognising heatstroke; sweating may continue. Do not give oral fluids when consciousness is impaired.

गर्मी से थकावट में ज्यादा पसीना, कमजोरी, मितली और चक्कर हो सकते हैं। हीटस्ट्रोक में खतरनाक गर्मी और मानसिक स्थिति बदलना आपात स्थिति है।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

छाया में ले जाएं, अतिरिक्त कपड़े हटाएं और ठंडा करें। सचेत और निगल सकने वाले को गर्मी की थकावट में तरल दें। संदिग्ध हीटस्ट्रोक में आपात सहायता और तेजी से सक्रिय ठंडक जरूरी है।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

हीटस्ट्रोक पहचानने के लिए पसीना रुकने का इंतजार न करें; पसीना जारी रह सकता है। चेतना प्रभावित हो तो मुंह से तरल न दें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Polycystic ovary syndrome is a hormonal and metabolic condition that can involve irregular ovulation, androgen excess and metabolic risk.

## Practical guidance

Diagnosis depends on clinical criteria and exclusion of other causes, not ultrasound alone. Symptoms may include irregular periods, acne, excess hair growth or difficulty conceiving.

## Important considerations and next steps

Management reflects goals: cycle protection, symptom relief, fertility and metabolic health. Discuss glucose screening, sustainable lifestyle and appropriate medicines; PCOS is not caused by personal failure.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

A complete blood count measures blood cells and related indices, including haemoglobin, white cells and platelets.

## Practical guidance

Low haemoglobin may suggest anaemia; white cell changes can reflect infection or other conditions; platelet abnormalities may affect bleeding or clotting. Reference ranges vary by laboratory and patient characteristics.

## Important considerations and next steps

Interpret trends and symptoms with a clinician. A CBC alone does not establish the cause of anaemia or infection; urgent symptoms should not wait for routine interpretation.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Cortisol is a steroid hormone produced by adrenal glands that helps regulate stress responses, metabolism, blood pressure and immune activity.

## Practical guidance

Levels normally vary with time of day and illness. Testing is used for specific suspected disorders and requires appropriate timing or specialised procedures.

## Important considerations and next steps

Sleep, activity and stress management support general health but do not treat adrenal disorders. Do not abruptly stop prescribed corticosteroids; discuss a taper if needed.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Benign prostatic enlargement can narrow urine flow and cause hesitancy, weak stream, frequency or nighttime urination. It is not the same as prostate cancer.

## Practical guidance

Clinical assessment may include urine tests, examination and selected PSA or bladder measurements. Treatment ranges from monitoring to medicines or procedures.

## Important considerations and next steps

Inability to pass urine, fever with urinary symptoms or visible blood requires prompt care. Avoid assuming every urinary symptom is due to the prostate.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Flexibility describes the available range of muscles and joints, while mobility also involves active control through that range.

## Practical guidance

Use gentle dynamic movements before activity and comfortable stretching or controlled joint movements as part of a regular routine. Progress gradually and adapt to your daily needs.

## Important considerations and next steps

Avoid forcing joints beyond comfortable range. People with hypermobility may need stability training rather than more stretching; persistent pain needs assessment.

## Further reading

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

## Understanding the topic

Occasional forgetfulness can occur with ageing, but persistent decline that interferes with daily activities may indicate a cognitive disorder.

## Practical guidance

Record examples such as missed appointments, getting lost or difficulty managing finances. Assessment may include cognitive testing, medication review and evaluation of treatable contributors.

## Important considerations and next steps

Sudden confusion is not typical gradual dementia and needs urgent assessment. Early evaluation supports planning, safety and caregiver support.

content_en:
## Understanding the topic

Malaria is caused by parasites transmitted through infected mosquitoes. Fever, chills, headache and fatigue can occur, and severe malaria may progress rapidly.

## Practical guidance

Seek prompt testing for fever with relevant exposure; microscopy or rapid diagnostic tests guide treatment. Medicines depend on parasite species, local resistance and individual factors.

## Important considerations and next steps

Confusion, seizures, breathing difficulty or severe weakness require urgent care. Prevent bites with nets, repellents and protective clothing; do not rely on self-prescribed antimalarials.

## Further reading

https://www.who.int/india/health-topics/

## Precautions and medical disclaimer

This educational information is not a substitute for individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your healthcare professional’s advice; in an emergency, seek immediate help.

मलेरिया संक्रमित मच्छर से फैलने वाले परजीवी के कारण होता है। बुखार, ठंड, सिरदर्द और थकान हो सकती है और गंभीर मलेरिया तेजी से बढ़ सकता है।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

संबंधित संपर्क के साथ बुखार में जल्दी जांच कराएं; माइक्रोस्कोपी या रैपिड टेस्ट उपचार तय करते हैं। दवा परजीवी, स्थानीय प्रतिरोध और व्यक्ति पर निर्भर है।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

भ्रम, दौरे, सांस की तकलीफ या बहुत कमजोरी में तुरंत मदद लें। मच्छरदानी, रिपेलेंट और ढकने वाले कपड़े लें; खुद से मलेरिया की दवा न लें।

## अधिक जानकारी

https://www.who.int/india/health-topics/

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।

## Understanding the topic

Type 2 diabetes involves insulin resistance and insufficient insulin secretion relative to needs. It can develop without noticeable symptoms.

## Practical guidance

Thirst, frequent urination or fatigue may occur. Blood glucose and HbA1c tests establish diagnosis with appropriate confirmation. Management may include diet, activity and medicines.

## Important considerations and next steps

Regular eye, kidney and foot assessment and cardiovascular risk management are important. Severe illness, vomiting, confusion or breathing changes requires urgent care.

https://www.who.int/india/health-topics/

## Understanding the topic

Aerobic exercise challenges the heart and lungs, while resistance training strengthens muscles. Both contribute to function and long-term health.

## Practical guidance

Walking, cycling or swimming can build aerobic capacity; bodyweight or resistance exercises train major muscle groups. Start at a tolerable level and progress gradually.

## Important considerations and next steps

Combine both across the week with recovery and balance work when relevant. Adapt the programme for disability, injury or chronic disease rather than chasing one ideal routine.

A balanced Indian diet provides a variety of nutrients through vegetables, fruits, pulses, grains, protein foods and appropriate fats.

Build a meal around sabzi, dal or another protein source, roti or rice in an appropriate portion, and curd or a suitable alternative. Choose whole fruit over juice and vary foods seasonally.

Limit excess salt, added sugar and frequent deep-fried snacks. Adjust portions and restrictions for individual needs, especially kidney disease, diabetes and pregnancy.

## Understanding the topic

LDL particles can contribute to arterial plaque, HDL is involved in cholesterol transport, and triglycerides are another circulating lipid linked to metabolic risk.

## Practical guidance

A lipid profile helps estimate cardiovascular risk alongside age, blood pressure, tobacco use, diabetes and family history. Treatment decisions are not based on one number alone.

## Important considerations and next steps

Activity, dietary quality and prescribed lipid-lowering treatment may reduce risk. High HDL does not automatically cancel high LDL; very high triglycerides need clinical attention.

https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html

## Understanding the topic

Proper medicine storage protects potency and prevents accidental ingestion. Requirements vary by formulation and product.

## Practical guidance

Keep original labelled packaging, check expiry and storage instructions, and use a locked place away from children, heat and moisture. Refrigerate only when required.

## Important considerations and next steps

Ask a pharmacist about local take-back or safe disposal options. Do not share expired or unused prescriptions or flush medicines unless specifically instructed.

Child development includes movement, communication, social interaction and problem-solving; growth includes changes in weight, length or height and head size in early life.

Use routine growth charts and age-appropriate developmental surveillance rather than comparing children informally. Play, responsive conversation and adequate nutrition support development.

Loss of previously acquired skills, persistent feeding difficulty or concerns about hearing, vision or milestones deserves timely paediatric assessment.

## Understanding the topic

Preventive checkups aim to detect important risks and diseases early, not to perform every available test annually.

## Practical guidance

Discuss age, family history, symptoms, pregnancy possibility and current conditions. Blood pressure, appropriate glucose or lipid assessment, vaccinations and evidence-based cancer screening may be useful depending on eligibility.

## Important considerations and next steps

Ask how a proposed test will change management and what false positives could mean. Symptoms require diagnostic evaluation rather than waiting for an annual package.

## विषय को समझें

निवारक स्वास्थ्य जांच का उद्देश्य महत्वपूर्ण जोखिम और बीमारी जल्दी पहचानना है, हर उपलब्ध परीक्षण हर साल करना नहीं।

## व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन

उम्र, पारिवारिक इतिहास, लक्षण, गर्भ की संभावना और मौजूदा बीमारी पर चर्चा करें। पात्रता अनुसार रक्तचाप, शर्करा, लिपिड, टीकाकरण और प्रमाण आधारित कैंसर स्क्रीनिंग उपयोगी हो सकती है।

## महत्वपूर्ण बातें और अगले कदम

पूछें जांच उपचार कैसे बदलेगी और गलत सकारात्मक परिणाम का क्या अर्थ होगा। लक्षणों में वार्षिक पैकेज का इंतजार नहीं, निदान जांच जरूरी है।

## सावधानियां और चिकित्सकीय अस्वीकरण

यह जानकारी केवल स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा के लिए है। यह व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सकीय सलाह, निदान या उपचार का विकल्प नहीं है। अपने स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ की सलाह मानें और आपात स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता लें।
